title: Practice token patterns
description: This starter harness tests patterns for four token classes used by a lexer.

steps.description: SPEC names the integer, identifier, float, and operator token classes. Each pattern slot starts as None.
CASES provides strings that should and should not match each token class.
The loop selects each specification and its test cases. An unfinished pattern prints a marker and skips its tests.

steps.question: How many unfinished markers appear in the initial run?
steps.answer: Four markers appear, one for INT, IDENT, FLOAT, and OP.

steps.description: Once a pattern is supplied, fullmatch checks each positive and negative case and prints whether it passes.
The initial INT pattern is None, so the loop reports that it is not written yet.
